_comment: LDAP/Active Directory provider configuration. Register this via: op auth provider create --config configs/ldap-provider.json

activeDirectoryNotes._comment: These notes document Active Directory-specific configuration choices. They are not used by OnePlatform.
activeDirectoryNotes.userAccountControlFilter: The bitwise filter (userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2) excludes disabled accounts. Bit 2 (0x0002) is the ACCOUNTDISABLE flag in AD.
activeDirectoryNotes.sAMAccountName: Used instead of uid because Active Directory does not populate the uid attribute by default. sAMAccountName is the pre-Windows 2000 logon name (e.g., jsmith).
activeDirectoryNotes.memberOfAttribute: AD natively populates memberOf on user objects via the linked attribute backlink. This avoids a separate group search when groupSearchBase is null. When groupSearchBase is set, the plugin performs an explicit group search instead.
activeDirectoryNotes.groupSearchBase: Set to OU=Groups to limit the group search scope. If your groups are in multiple OUs, set this to the baseDN (DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com) and use a more specific groupSearchFilter.
activeDirectoryNotes.tlsCertificate: For production, ensure the AD server's TLS certificate is signed by a CA trusted by the OnePlatform host. Self-signed certificates require adding the CA cert to the system trust store or setting rejectUnauthorized to false (not recommended for production).
